run_metadata.coverage_summary: Degraded, SEARCH-ONLY run. The hard egress block seen on recent runs persists: the session network policy denies direct HTTPS to tender hosts (WebFetch to https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm returned DNS ENOTFOUND; curl CONNECT tunnels to tenders.gov.au, vendorpanel.com.au and tenders.nsw.gov.au were refused with proxy 403). No buyer-originated detail page, feed/API or tender document could be opened; discovery was limited to WebSearch (US-indexed, lagging the run date, returning mostly cached snippets and third-party aggregator pages). Tier 1 (AusTender; NSW buy.nsw/eTendering; VIC Buying for Victoria; QLD QTenders->VendorPanel/supply.qld.gov.au; WA; SA; TAS; NT QTOL; ACT Tenders) swept by search. Tier 2 (local government via VendorPanel and council sites; universities; water corporations - Sydney Water, Melbourne Water, SA Water, Water Corporation WA, Greater Western Water) swept by search. Tier 3 MANDATORY check done by search (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery; BHP GCMS; Rio Tinto Ariba) - every corporate channel remained registration-gated or invitation-only with no publicly-visible open RFx; recorded as portals only, none fabricated. Net: the six still-open, buyer-corroborated opportunities carried from the 2026-11-17 run were re-confirmed as still open and re-asserted (NSW ~$80M Master Media RFT closing 27 Nov re-corroborated by trade press; Brisbane Gardner Road Doc115483155 closing 7 Dec and Prebble St Bikeway Doc118000917 closing 11 Dec re-corroborated against the BCC current-tenders listing; TfNSW New England Hwy Maitland Westbound ROI 26.0000139291.0941.ROI publish 9 Nov closing 11 Dec re-corroborated; Tenders ACT SL20260630 closing 1 Dec and PIMA0014211 closing 3 Dec carried forward). No genuinely new buyer-originated opportunity could be verified beyond these carryovers. Three new source signals were surfaced and recorded (Melbourne Water via the Zycus Supplier Network; SA Water Supplier Portal; Water Corporation WA supplier/bidder portal). All six tenders remain headline-only and UNVERIFIED on an opened buyer page. No opportunity, deliverable, date, value or contact was fabricated.
gaps: HARD EGRESS BLOCK (unchanged from recent runs): all direct HTTPS to tender hosts is denied by the session network policy. WebFetch to https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm returned DNS ENOTFOUND, and curl CONNECT tunnels to www.tenders.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au and www.tenders.nsw.gov.au were refused by the proxy with HTTP 403, so no buyer-originated detail page, feed/API or tender document could be opened. To restore full discovery these hosts should be allowed in the session network settings: www.tenders.gov.au, buy.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au, qtenders.hpw.qld.gov.au / supply.qld.gov.au, www.tenders.wa.gov.au, www.tenders.sa.gov.au, www.tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, www.tenders.act.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, service.ariba.com, gateway.icn.org.au, www.brisbane.qld.gov.au, estimateone.com, and individual council/university/utility/corporate sites.

Every tender captured this run is headline-only and UNVERIFIED on the buyer's own page. Titles, reference numbers and closing dates come from WebSearch snippets of trade press, buyer-page snapshots and aggregators, not from an opened buyer detail page. Deliverables, requirements, eligibility, evaluation criteria, submission mechanics, value and contacts are therefore null and still need a detail pass once egress is restored.

WebSearch index lags the run date (2026-11-18) and is US-indexed. Almost all other surfaced notices had already closed (e.g. NSW Health linen-services consultant HI26363 closed 2 Oct; Univ. of Sydney Curriculum Management Technologies closed 4 Sep; numerous university EOIs closed earlier in 2026) and were correctly excluded, NOT captured. Genuinely recent (last 24-48h) buyer-originated notices are almost certainly undercounted.

The two ACT entries (Tenders ACT SL20260630, PIMA0014211) were carried from the 2026-11-17 run; they derive from a WebSearch summary of the Tenders ACT open-tenders listing, not an opened record, and that snapshot contained at least one garbled release/closing date, so both close dates and the PIMA0014211 procurement_type still need confirmation on the live portal once egress is restored.

Unconfirmed items seen only in aggregator/search summaries and therefore NOT captured as tenders, pending verification on the buyer's own portal once egress is restored: buy.nsw Solar PV Design/Supply/Install/Maintenance (reported closing ~9 Dec 2026); DPIRD MERI Panel (reported closing ~8 Dec 2026); Greater Western Water potable-water-service-upgrade RFT (foreshadowed for release Aug 2026); Wannon Water 2026/27 forward tender schedule items.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery, BHP GCMS, Rio Tinto Ariba, and major retail/bank/telco e-sourcing hubs) remained registration-gated or invitation-only; no authenticated supplier session is available, so no corporate opportunity could be read. Recorded as portals only; no corporate tender fabricated. Management-consultancy / invitation-only RFPs are out of scope by definition and were not invented.
All six re-asserted opportunities are carryovers from earlier runs (existing dedup_keys) re-confirmed as still open via this run's searches; they were not freshly discovered this run.
recommended_seed_additions: Melbourne Water - Zycus Supplier Network: Melbourne Water runs supplier registration and sourcing through the Zycus Supplier Network (a distinct e-sourcing platform not previously recorded by this routine); worth tracking as a buyer-originated GBE channel.

SA Water - Supplier Portal (https://www.sawater.com.au/): SA Water conducts its tender process and proposal lodgement exclusively through its own Supplier Portal; add to the water-corporation sample rotation.
Water Corporation (WA) - Supplier/Bidder Portal: Water Corporation distributes bid documents via its own supplier/bidder portal for registered suppliers; add to the water-corporation sample rotation.

Once egress is restored, open the buyer detail pages for all six carried opportunities (buy.nsw NSW Master Media RFT; Brisbane Doc115483155 and Doc118000917; TfNSW 26.0000139291.0941.ROI; Tenders ACT SL20260630 and PIMA0014211) and the unconfirmed buy.nsw / GWW / Wannon Water items listed in gaps, and complete the deliverables/requirements detail pass.

tenders.title: NSW Government Master Media Services - Request for Tender
tenders.category: Media planning and buying / advertising services
tenders.description: Whole-of-NSW-Government request for tender for a master media planning and buying partner, reported at an estimated value of ~$80 million. The RFT is open to Australian-owned independent agencies, which may bid alone or as a consortium, with value-for-money and cost transparency emphasised.
tenders.eligibility: Reported open to Australian-owned independent media agencies, able to bid alone or as a consortium (per trade-press coverage; not verified on the buyer page this run).
tenders.submission_method: Lodge via NSW eTendering / buy.nsw (not verified this run)
tenders.reasoning: Carryover re-confirmed again this run (2026-11-18) via WebSearch of trade press (B&T, Mediaweek, Marketing-Interactive) reporting the ~$80M NSW Government master media RFT as open and closing 27 November 2026, with a shortlist expected Jan 2027 and a second RFT stage from Feb 2027. Buyer-originated channel is NSW eTendering/buy.nsw; the buyer detail page could not be opened due to the persistent egress block.
tenders.notes: HEADLINE-ONLY and UNVERIFIED on the buyer's own page. Value (~$80M) and closing date (27 Nov 2026) from corroborating trade-press reports, not an opened buy.nsw record. Closes in ~9 days; marked closing-soon. Tender id, closing time, documents and contacts still null (egress block).
